acceptance_criteria.text: Local mode persists virtual time and bounded market replay progress as a versioned scenario snapshot in PostgreSQL; production behavior remains unchanged.
On process restart, local mode restores the scenario snapshot deterministically and records startup reconciliation status with source and snapshot revision.
Reset returns fixture state and persists it; advancing replay or setting virtual time persists the updated state.

A Docker-backed runtime verification can restart the application process and compare expected/observed time, replay cursor, and normalized account/market state without credentials or external network access.
